title: xfr-engine: deterministic financial engine for the shadow price of credit
description: Python implementation of the mathematical core of the manuscript 'The Shadow Price of Credit: An Explainable-AI Decision-Support System for Corporate Recapitalization under Credit-Line Withdrawal' (M. de Alencar Netto, 2026): cash and debt identities, minimum-equity linear program (HiGHS), credit-to-equity substitution index (CES/ISC), directional shadow price of credit capacity, infeasibility diagnosis and automated consistency tests. Version 0.3.0 adds the institutional layer of the companion paper on interest on equity (JCP), credit withdrawal and equity substitution in Brazil and the United States: corporate tax, deductible interest with cap, loss-offset limit, JCP with TJLP base and ceilings, withholding, interest-rate channel and DIP financing, as a mixed-integer LP; the net cost of substitution (CLS); Experiment I (institutional comparative statics, channel decomposition, DIP sensitivity) and 36 automated tests.
